meta.title: Battle Dialogue · A Flash of Thunder
meta.description: In that moment, in all directions, light and dark split.

units.rawText: Look out, here she comes!
units.displayText: Look out, here she comes!

spans.text: Look out, here she comes!

units.rawText: The battle begins. We stick close to Atlas as we enter the designated passage one after another, aiming to draw Caina in.
units.displayText: The battle begins. We stick close to Atlas as we enter the designated passage one after another, aiming to draw Caina in.

spans.text: The battle begins. We stick close to Atlas as we enter the designated passage one after another, aiming to draw Caina in.

units.rawText: Caina's coming after us, so don't get caught up in fighting her. She's brought a mixed horde of Impactors and Twiners with her, too!
units.displayText: Caina's coming after us, so don't get caught up in fighting her. She's brought a mixed horde of Impactors and Twiners with her, too!

spans.text: Caina's coming after us, so don't get caught up in fighting her. She's brought a mixed horde of Impactors and Twiners with her, too!

units.rawText: This is the place! Get ready, Atlas!
units.displayText: This is the place! Get ready, Atlas!

spans.text: This is the place! Get ready, Atlas!

units.rawText: Roger that!
units.displayText: Roger that!

spans.text: Roger that!

units.rawText: The familiar red figure finally appears on the other side of the passage.
units.displayText: The familiar red figure finally appears on the other side of the passage.

spans.text: The familiar red figure finally appears on the other side of the passage.

units.rawText: So that's where you were hiding!
units.displayText: So that's where you were hiding!

spans.text: So that's where you were hiding!

units.rawText: That hurt just now... But it was pretty interesting! I haven't felt pain like that in a while! Hahaha, this is one hell of a mission!
units.displayText: That hurt just now... But it was pretty interesting! I haven't felt pain like that in a while! Hahaha, this is one hell of a mission!

spans.text: That hurt just now... But it was pretty interesting! I haven't felt pain like that in a while! Hahaha, this is one hell of a mission!

units.rawText: Caina grabs a Low-Order Entropic by her leg and slowly crushes it to bits. The liquid Entropy that oozes out seems to flow into her body, and she grins maniacally.
units.displayText: Caina grabs a Low-Order Entropic by her leg and slowly crushes it to bits. The liquid Entropy that oozes out seems to flow into her body, and she grins maniacally.

spans.text: Caina grabs a Low-Order Entropic by her leg and slowly crushes it to bits. The liquid Entropy that oozes out seems to flow into her body, and she grins maniacally.

units.rawText: Come on, let's go all-out! I can't wait any more!
units.displayText: Come on, let's go all-out! I can't wait any more!

spans.text: Come on, let's go all-out! I can't wait any more!

units.rawText: Then as you wish—Blade of Severance!
units.displayText: Then as you wish—Blade of Severance!

spans.text: Then as you wish—Blade of Severance!

units.rawText: Boom—
units.displayText: Boom—

spans.text: Boom—

units.rawText: His greatsword arcs through the air and sweeps away all the Low-Order Entropics around Caina. Rock shards fly everywhere, and monsters howl as the greatsword strikes home.
units.displayText: His greatsword arcs through the air and sweeps away all the Low-Order Entropics around Caina. Rock shards fly everywhere, and monsters howl as the greatsword strikes home.

spans.text: His greatsword arcs through the air and sweeps away all the Low-Order Entropics around Caina. Rock shards fly everywhere, and monsters howl as the greatsword strikes home.

units.rawText: Alcyone, now!
units.displayText: Alcyone, now!

spans.text: Alcyone, now!

units.rawText: Alcyone bites her lip, and the anger blazing in her eyes seemingly heats up the passage. The girl clenches her fist savagely, and the "surprise" that Atlas hid in the walls earlier detonates in response.
units.displayText: Alcyone bites her lip, and the anger blazing in her eyes seemingly heats up the passage. The girl clenches her fist savagely, and the "surprise" that Atlas hid in the walls earlier detonates in response.

spans.text: Alcyone bites her lip, and the anger blazing in her eyes seemingly heats up the passage. The girl clenches her fist savagely, and the "surprise" that Atlas hid in the walls earlier detonates in response.

units.rawText: Boomboomboom—
units.displayText: Boomboomboom—

spans.text: Boomboomboom—

units.rawText: The explosion blends with the sound of the shifting of the great walls. The noise echoes through the depths of the passage, and in Caina's throat.
units.displayText: The explosion blends with the sound of the shifting of the great walls. The noise echoes through the depths of the passage, and in Caina's throat.

spans.text: The explosion blends with the sound of the shifting of the great walls. The noise echoes through the depths of the passage, and in Caina's throat.

units.rawText: <color=red><size=40>Urgh—You—Why you—Guh—</size></color>
units.displayText: Urgh—You—Why you—Guh—

spans.text: Urgh—You—Why you—Guh—

units.rawText: Alcyone, on to the next location.
units.displayText: Alcyone, on to the next location.

spans.text: Alcyone, on to the next location.

units.rawText: Atlas picks up Electra and pats Alcyone on the back.
units.displayText: Atlas picks up Electra and pats Alcyone on the back.

spans.text: Atlas picks up Electra and pats Alcyone on the back.

units.rawText: Feel better now?
units.displayText: Feel better now?

spans.text: Feel better now?

units.rawText: ...Yeah. Thanks, Atlas.
units.displayText: ...Yeah. Thanks, Atlas.

spans.text: ...Yeah. Thanks, Atlas.
